SELECT id, parentId, type, title, description, badgeText FROM ( SELECT P.PROJ_ID AS id, NULL AS parentId, 'PROJECT' AS type, P.PROJ_NM AS title, '프로젝트' AS description, P.PROJ_STAT_CD AS badgeText FROM TB_PROJECT P INNER JOIN TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM ON P.PROJ_ID = PM.PROJ_ID AND PM.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND PM.LEAVE_DT IS NULL WHERE P.PROJ_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT S.SCHD_ID AS id, NULL AS parentId, 'SCHEDULE' AS type, S.SCHD_NM AS title, '일정' AS description, TO_CHAR(S.BEGIN_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS badgeText FROM TB_INTG_SCHD S INNER JOIN TB_SCHD_TARGET ST ON S.SCHD_ID = ST.SCHD_ID INNER JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON E.EMP_ID = #{empId} WHERE S.SCHD_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND ( ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '001' OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '002' AND ST.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{empId})) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '003' AND E.EXEC_YN = 'Y') OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '004' AND ST.TARGET_ID = E.DEPT_CD) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '005' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_PROJ_MEMBER PM WHERE PM.PROJ_ID = TO_NUMBER(ST.TARGET_ID) AND PM.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND PM.LEAVE_DT IS NULL )) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '006' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_TASK_PTCPT TP WHERE TP.TASK_ID = TO_NUMBER(ST.TARGET_ID) AND TP.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND TP.LEAVE_DT IS NULL )) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '007' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_MTNG_PTCPT MP WHERE MP.MTNG_ID = TO_NUMBER(ST.TARGET_ID) AND MP.EMP_ID = #{empId} )) OR (ST.TARGET_TYPE_CD = '008' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_CONF_RM_RSRV CR WHERE CR.RSRV_EMP_ID = #{empId} AND CR.RSRV_ID = TO_NUMBER(ST.TARGET_ID) )) )
UNION ALL
SELECT M.MTNG_ID AS id, NULL AS parentId, 'MEETING' AS type, M.MTNG_NM AS title, '회의' AS description, TO_CHAR(M.BEGIN_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS badgeText FROM TB_MTNG M INNER JOIN TB_MTNG_PTCPT MP ON M.MTNG_ID = MP.MTNG_ID AND MP.EMP_ID = #{empId} WHERE M.MTNG_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT T.TASK_ID AS id, T.PROJ_ID AS parentId, 'TASK' AS type, T.TASK_NM AS title, '업무' AS description, T.TASK_STAT_CD AS badgeText FROM TB_TASK T INNER JOIN TB_TASK_PTCPT TP ON T.TASK_ID = TP.TASK_ID AND TP.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND TP.LEAVE_DT IS NULL WHERE T.TASK_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT E.EDU_ID AS id, NULL AS parentId, 'EDUCATION' AS type, E.EDU_NM AS title, '교육' AS description, E.EDU_BEGIN_YMD AS badgeText FROM TB_EDU_MGMT E INNER JOIN TB_EDU_ATND_RLTM EA ON E.EDU_ID = EA.EDU_ID AND EA.EMP_ID = #{empId} WHERE E.EDU_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
UNION ALL
SELECT MM.MAIL_MSG_ID AS id, NULL AS parentId, 'MAIL' AS type, MM.MAIL_SJ AS title, '메일' AS description, TO_CHAR(MM.MAIL_SNDNG_DT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS badgeText FROM TB_MAIL_MESSAGE MM WHERE MM.MAIL_SJ LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND MM.EMP_ID = #{empId} AND MM.DEL_YN = 'N' AND MM.DRAFT_YN = 'N' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SEARCH_HIST (SEARCH_HIST_ID, EMP_ID, KEYWORD, REG_DT) VALUES (SEQ_SEARCH_HIST.NEXTVAL, #{empId}, #{keyword}, SYSDATE)

SELECT recent_item_id, emp_id, item_type, item_id, accessed_dt FROM TB_RECENT_ITEM WHERE emp_id = #{empId} ORDER BY accessed_dt DESC
